sections.advice: Fort Collins → Poudre Canyon is 61 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Cache la Poudre North Park Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 9.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Cameron Pass → Walden
scenicChapters.narrative: 3132 m come off over 46 km at around 6.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

cache-la-poudre-north-park-scenic-byway.story: Out of Fort Collins, one way: 130 km, roughly 2 h 06 in the saddle. On the way it passes Poudre Canyon and Cameron Pass. The highest point is about 3,150 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
